## 8. Archival interpretation and later controls

`S2C_CA_REPORT.md`, opening verdict: small mixed exploratory improvement; equal-year C3 MSE0.1104% below CLOCK-C3, F21 worse, improvement dominated by F24; no universal promotion. Signed auxiliary correlations weak/inconsistent. This interpretation is deliberately sealed.

Later controls, documentary rounded references only (not recomputed): `reports/codex_sessions/2026-10-29_114323_hf20_classical_volatility.md` §2/11 reports HAR-CAL MSE0.000109068193648 and ROLL60 IC0.318689978; that study used own global raw-A calibration, so it is not an isolated original-C3 architecture contrast. `reports/codex_sessions/2026-10-29_201017_hf20_garch_matched_calibration.md` §2 reports HAR versus S2-C MSE+2.0788% under G and+2.4212% under IO; its initially strict-stationarity GARCH arm was partial/blocked, later separately amended. Do not conflate those calibration packages with original S2-C C3, or treat partial GARCH as a negative fitted-model result.
